name: zennoposter-mcp
description: Official MCP servers for ZennoPoster and ZennoDroid: edit automation projects, run and monitor tasks, drive browser instances and Android devices. Requires ZennoPoster 7.9.2+ or ZennoDroid 2.6.1+ on Windows. Every server runs on your machine and has to be started before a client can connect; what it may do is bounded by the scopes and the permission tier of the API key you issue in the product.
